text:
maya peters: Heads up — Customer A asked for a legal-hold playbook we can hand to their security/forensics team. Need clarity on operational steps, retention toggles, and BYOK implications. Can product + ops + legal review?

tom li: thanks maya. do we have a concrete ask list from the customer?

maya peters: short list they sent: 1) immediate freeze of tenant data on legal hold; 2) exportable immutable evidence bundle; 3) auditable access logs with KMS key provenance; 4) rollback/unhold process and SLA (they want 24h max for removal once court order lifted)

julie (legal): quick flag — unhold SLA tied to legal jurisdiction is risky. we should offer target SLAs but include exceptions when court orders require longer holds. also must preserve chain-of-custody metadata for any exports.

ashwin rao: from ops perspective, MVP can be: a) a tenant-level toggle -> mark legal_hold=true in our metadata store, b) user-facing export job that snapshots manifests + signed checksums, c) snapshot storage in cold archive w/ WORM-ish retention for X days. we need to define X (default 365?).

eric dunne: BYOK notes: if customer uses BYOK (their KMS), we can't produce decrypted evidence unless we have key escrow or the customer supplies a wrapped decryption key. we should surface this clearly in the playbook. also need to record which key version was used for each exported blob.

tom li: good point. can we include a flow for three cases: hosted keys, customer-managed keys (BYOK), and vault-escrow?

ashwin rao: yes. proposed flow: - hosted keys: ops can trigger snapshot -> decrypt and bundle -> sign with platform key. - BYOK: snapshot still stored encrypted; export package references the ciphertext and key-id; customer must decrypt. - escrow: we provide an escrow API to accept a temporary unwrap token from customer for export ops; log everything.

julie (legal): escrow introduces legal review overhead. we should make escrow opt-in and require an executed data-handling addendum. also log the reason and identity for any unwraps.

maya peters: product ask: what are the minimal UI/API surfaces? Need a proposal we can send to the customer by EOD tomorrow.

eric dunne: API surfaces: POST /tenants/:id/legal_hold {action: "apply"|"release", reason, initiated_by}, GET /tenants/:id/legal_hold/export?since=..., GET /evidence/:export_id/manifest. Add header X-Key-Id for BYOK metadata.

ashwin rao: ops runbook snippet (internal): 
```
# apply hold
curl -X POST "$BASE/api/tenants/123/legal_hold" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"action":"apply","reason":"subpoena","initiated_by":"cust-support"}'
# create export (async job)
POST /api/tenants/123/legal_hold/export {"since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}
# check job
GET /api/jobs/EXPORT-UUID/status
```

julie (legal): include audit fields: initiated_by, approver (if required), justification text, and link to external legal matter id. these must be immutable once hold applied.

tom li: scope question — do we require hold to prevent deletions only, or also freeze live updates? customer explicitly asked to freeze "tenant data" — need to confirm they expect full read-only state or just backup snapshots.

maya peters: I'll ask them to clarify, but recommend we default to preventing destructive ops (deletes/compactions) and include an optional full-readonly mode as a premium capability.

eric dunne: storage implications: frozen data + snapshot retention increases costs. propose: default retention 365d, optional extension to 7 years for enterprise deals. also need billing change for long-term cold storage.

ashwin rao: rollout plan: 1) internal ops-only alpha (cron jobs + API) 2) partner pilot with 2 customers (one hosted-keys, one BYOK) 3) GA with console toggle + audit UI + export package support. estimate 8 weeks alpha -> pilot -> 6 weeks pilot -> GA depending on legal approvals.

julie (legal): I'll prepare the required contract addenda and escrow checklist. also drafting the acceptable use policy clause for legal hold unwraps.

maya peters: thanks. Can each owner post a short PRD bullet list by EOD? I'll collate and send to customer.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for branch feature/legal-hold-runbook (build 472). :rocket:

ashwin rao: will do. attaching internal risk checklist in the PRD: [privacy impact assessment, cost delta estimate, retention taxonomy mapping, key lifecycle checklist].

eric dunne: adding technical checklist: key-version logging, signed manifests, checksum + signature verification steps, export TTL, and replay protection for unwrap tokens.

maya peters: perfect — I'll collect and draft the playbook. expecting follow-ups from the customer re: readonly vs prevent-deletes.

julie (legal): note for FYI — if the case involves cross-border hold, we may need to route exports through region-specific data rooms. include that as a constraint.

maya peters: noted. thanks everyone. I'll share the draft in this thread when ready. :pray:
